[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This registry records two Nautilus Cryptomine facility entries in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, in the vicinity of the Susquehanna nuclear power plant, a location known from other sources to host cryptocurrency mining infrastructure powered under agreements with the plants operator, Talen Energy. However, this session was unable to independently corroborate the specific Nautilus Cryptomine entity, its ownership structure, or its relationship to Talen Energy: Wikipedia returned only cache-only content that could not be fetched, a DataCenterDynamics search returned a 404 error, TeraWulfs own site described its own five data center locations (Lake Mariner Data, Justified Data, Muskie Data, Lake Hawkeye Data, and Chesapeake Data & Energy) without mentioning Nautilus Cryptomine, and Talen Energys Wikipedia page mentioned only a separate Cumulus Data Center Campus sold to Amazon Web Services in March 2024, with no mention of Nautilus Cryptomine specifically. No operator attribution is made for these facilities and none is fabricated; this remains an open research item.
